extracted.intended_audience: federal executives and agency personnel with contracting responsibilities
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and training for federal agency staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-76 contracting-out policies, including cost comparisons and drafting performance work statements. The page is an announcement/letter describing a conference and workshops to ensure agency compliance and practical implementation of A-76 changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: improving the efficiency and effectiveness of Government
rubrics_metrics.description: Goal of 'improving the efficiency and effectiveness of Government' (as stated in OMB Circular A-76).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as the Administration's overarching objective motivating A-76 contracting-out policies; agency actions and compliance are expected to further this goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure compliance with new OMB A-76 policy guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: All agencies will be expected to comply with new policy guidelines issued by OMB (summary and analysis provided at the conference).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conference is designed to provide personnel with contracting responsibilities 'all the information they will need to ensure compliance.' Agencies should review the summary of changes and analyze implications for their contracting activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and apply the new OMB changes and their implications for contracting activities
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'summary of the new OMB changes and an analysis of their implications for all contracting activities.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should assess how policy changes affect existing and future contracting decisions across the agency; the conference features presentations and analyses to support that assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address personnel issues in contracting-out implementations
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert presentations on personnel issues related to contracting out under A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance likely covers treatment of affected employees, personnel policies, staffing impacts, and labor/HR considerations when moving work to contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the procurement process consistent with A-76
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert presentations on the procurement process as it relates to A-76 implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must align procurement steps, solicitations, evaluations, and award procedures with A-76 requirements; the conference provides process-level instruction and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement quality assurance/quality control procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert presentations on quality assurance/quality control procedures for contracted work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes establishing QA/QC measures to ensure contractors meet performance standards and that contracting out maintains or improves service quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use implementation case studies for practical 'how-to' guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation case studies will provide practical, 'how-to' guidance on the new A-76 guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Case studies are intended to show step-by-step examples of implementing A-76 policies in real scenarios, demonstrating pitfalls and best practices for effective application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct Cost Comparison Studies (one of two major A-76 activities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional full-day workshop on Cost Comparison Studies — identified as a major activity required by A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cost Comparison Studies are required under A-76 to compare in-house performance costs versus contractor costs; training covers methodology, computation, assumptions, and documentation needed to support decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare a Performance Work Statement (one of two major A-76 activities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional full-day workshop on the Performance Work Statement — identified as a major activity required by A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Performance Work Statement (PWS) must clearly describe required services and performance standards; training covers drafting PWS content, measurable performance metrics, and linkage to cost comparisons and contract oversight.
